priorities.summary: Elevation of privilege in Azure AI Language service, rated the maximum CVSS 10.0 in September Patch Tuesday. Cloud-service tenants should apply Microsoft's remediation as AI service flaws can expose downstream tenant data.

Elevation of privilege in Microsoft Entra ID disclosed in September Patch Tuesday. A flaw in the cloud identity plane reaching near-maximum CVSS deserves priority for tenants relying on Entra for SSO and conditional access.

Pre-authentication path traversal with unsafe file upload in Check Point Security Management Server lets an unauthenticated remote attacker upload and execute arbitrary scripts. Exploited in targeted attacks since July 23 and added to CISA KEV on Sep 22 with a Sep 25 remediation deadline.

model.name: GPT-6 Sol & Luna (OpenAI)
model.summary: OpenAI expanded its GPT-6 lineup on Sep 22 with two cheaper models: Sol ($2/$10 per million tokens) for coding and professional work, and Luna ($0.10/$0.50) for high-volume tasks. Both halve their GPT-5.6 counterparts' prices while inheriting GPT-6 Astra's reasoning, coding, and computer-use improvements.
